title: Motion Graphs
summary: Reading displacement–time and velocity–time graphs: slopes, areas and shapes.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 4: Describing Motion Around Us

objectives: I can find velocity from the slope of a displacement–time graph.
I can find acceleration and displacement from a velocity–time graph.
I can describe motion from graph shapes.
misconceptions: A flat v–t line means the object has stopped.
The area under a v–t graph is the acceleration.
Graphs show the shape of the path.
